findings.message: Six final/delayed pairs are parallel forms with the same solution structure. This supports short-term retention of taught procedures; it does not independently demonstrate broad transfer. Pair1 factor-cancel-subtract,2 numerical negative powers/root,3 rational domain,4 abs/sign,5 reverse percentage price change,6 log/power sum.

No exact verbatim question clone within the12 or compared with the120 previously reviewed prompt bank. Many structural near-clones of taught examples exist. Phrase independent assessment narrowly: unseen numerical/context variants, not independent skills.

For stronger transfer include richer unseen contexts and combined constraints, keep variants from reusable practice/explanation exposure before scheduled assessment, and distinguish first unseen attempt from repeats.

Percent items05 are valid NMT school mathematics but reverse-percentage prerequisite is not taught explicitly in existing expressions lesson. Add short base-quantity/percent explanation or identify as a prerequisite diagnostic; otherwise a result conflates algebra with untaught percent knowledge.
Ten of12 MEDIUM labels are routine one-step or direct formula tasks, judged EASY; price reverse-percentage items suitably MEDIUM.
